statement: Watercolour, made slowly. This is the archive — every work on record, each with a permanent address, and no claim the record cannot support.
story: Juan Pabrua came to painting through drawing, and through graphic design — the discipline of deciding what a page says before deciding how it looks. Watercolour kept the drawing and loosened the hand.

The work is experimental by temperament: pigment is allowed to move, edges are allowed to fail, and the paper is allowed to have an opinion. What stays constant is the subject — everyday Filipino life, ordinary things looked at long enough to become worth the paper.
He paints what moves him. Gratitude is the method: attention first, then the brush.
